newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai tax revenue hits record high in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai tax revenue hits record high in Q1.

text.p: Tax revenue for the city of Shanghai hit a record high of 7.332 billion yuan in the first quarter of 1997, up 24.4 percent year-on-year, the Business News said on Friday.
Tax collected from domestic firms contributed 2.64 billion yuan, up 11.3 percent from the same period in 1996, while individual income tax rose by 41 percent to 832 million yuan, the newspaper said.
It did not give specific figures for another important contributor -- foreign-funded firms.
